detailed_feedback.in_text_citation_format: The in-text citations are inconsistent, with some using brackets like '[16, 26]' and others not following a uniform style. Adopting a single style, such as brackets with comma-separated numbers, throughout the manuscript would improve clarity and professionalism.
detailed_feedback.reference_list_format: References are numbered but vary in formatting, with inconsistent punctuation, spacing, and order of elements. Standardizing to a specific style, such as APA or Vancouver, with uniform punctuation, author formatting, and inclusion of all necessary details, would enhance readability and verification.
detailed_feedback.citation_style_consistency: The manuscript mixes citation styles, leading to confusion. Choosing one style (e.g., Vancouver) and applying it consistently across in-text citations and references will improve scholarly appearance.
detailed_feedback.reference_completeness: Several references lack complete bibliographic details, such as volume, issue, pages, or publication year. Ensuring each reference contains all necessary elements will facilitate source retrieval and uphold academic standards.
detailed_feedback.doi_url_formatting: DOIs are inconsistently formatted; some include 'https://doi.org/', others do not. Standardizing DOI formatting to include the full URL enhances accessibility and ease of use.
detailed_feedback.author_name_formatting: Author names are inconsistently formatted, with some full names, some initials, and varying order. Applying a uniform format, such as 'Last Name, First Initials', improves professionalism.
detailed_feedback.publication_date_formatting: Dates are variably formatted, with some including month/year, others only year. Consistent date formatting (e.g., Year) across all references supports clarity.
detailed_feedback.journal_name_formatting: Journal names are inconsistently abbreviated or spelled out, with inconsistent italics or capitalization. Uniform formatting, such as italics for journal titles, enhances visual consistency.
detailed_feedback.volume_issue_page_formatting: Volume, issue, and page numbers are inconsistently presented, sometimes with parentheses, commas, or spaces. Standardizing this formatting improves source identification.
detailed_feedback.cross_reference_accuracy: In-text citations do not always match reference list entries, and some references are cited multiple times with different formats. Ensuring accurate cross-referencing and consistent numbering is crucial for scholarly integrity.

summary: Overall, the manuscript exhibits significant inconsistencies in citation formatting, referencing completeness, and style adherence. Implementing a uniform citation style, ensuring complete and accurate reference entries, and maintaining consistency throughout will substantially improve the scholarly quality and professionalism of the document.
